subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “He had thought he was bad at copying notes because he was slow.”?
options: He could hear the teacher clearly, see the board well, and ask questions easily.
People cannot change a habit they cannot see.
It simply appeared by the window one Monday morning.
In fact, he simply could not see well.
